evals.prompt: Update readme.md to reflect relay.py and decisions.md. Make it clearer and easier to scan. Only readme.md is authorized for editing; preserve its information and safety warnings.
evals.expected_output: An in-place README improvement that loads the skill without naming it in the request, preserves unique facts, corrects current timeout to 30 seconds, and labels the approved 60-second target unimplemented.
assertions: Loads docs-maintenance before editing documentation
Explains purpose before detailed settings
Reports 30 seconds as current timeout
Retains 60 seconds as agreed but unimplemented
Preserves 3 attempts, 2-second backoff, 7-day audit retention, and JSONL exports
Preserves the complete safety warning verbatim
Preserves the retention link, launch decision, and relay-west example
Changes only readme.md
Does not create directories or invent runtime verification
Applies active paragraph limits and bold prose lead-ins to the edited document

evals.prompt: Review readme.md against relay.py and decisions.md. Propose how to separate its concerns and make the big picture clear. Do not edit files or reorganize the repository.
evals.expected_output: A read-only, source-grounded concern map and minimal scoped proposal, preserving facts and approval boundaries.
assertions: Explains the product before proposing its document structure
Proposes only a split of the named document and necessary link updates
Names approval as the gate before restructuring
Identifies current versus planned timeout honestly
Does not modify files
Applies active paragraph limits and bold prose lead-ins to the proposal

evals.prompt: Update docs/setup.md only. The working tree already includes someone else's edited docs/security.md and an unrelated archived plan. You may inspect references needed to validate setup.
evals.expected_output: Work stays scoped to setup; unrelated Git changes and archival snapshots remain untouched.
assertions: Does not treat all dirty files as session scope
Does not refactor unrelated documentation
Proposes approval for any additional required edit

evals.prompt: Condense a touched guide. Its owner approved a new retry design, but the implementation still uses the old behavior. Preserve the deprecated configuration and its migration warning.
evals.expected_output: An information-preserving edit distinguishes current behavior, accepted future design, and superseded guidance without claiming deployment.
assertions: Keeps agreed behavior separate from implemented behavior
Retains the deprecated configuration where readers can find it
Preserves the warning verbatim despite length
Does not silently remove contradictions

evals.prompt: Summarize an existing Markdown document. Do not change it. Its navigation looks poor, but I only want the summary.
evals.expected_output: A summary without unsolicited edits or a repository-wide documentation review.
assertions: Does not treat reading Markdown as permission to edit
Does not expand the task into a refactor

evals.prompt: You notice a stale claim while editing a company guide, but the source system is inaccessible. The repository forbids retained session records.
evals.expected_output: The uncertainty is reported without fabricating current behavior, exporting company evidence, or creating forbidden records.
assertions: Reports the source limitation
Does not assert unverified behavior as current fact
Creates no prohibited record
Keeps company evidence in its workspace

evals.prompt: Refactor an AGENTS.md, a SKILL.md, and a byte-preserved historical Markdown snapshot.
evals.expected_output: Instruction and skill changes route to their owners; the frozen snapshot is not rewritten as ordinary documentation.
assertions: Routes agent instructions to agents-md
Routes skill definitions to agent-skills-creator
Does not rewrite the historical snapshot without explicit authority to alter the record
